bugs.title: Heartbeat starved during siren pulse
bugs.description: runSirenBurst() blocks in delay(SIREN_MS) at line 38 for the full 2000 ms, so loop() cannot reach the heartbeat check at lines 60-65. Measured gaps of 2000 ms and 2249 ms between 'hb' lines confirm the serial output stops for the whole pulse. Expected /^hb$/ every 250 ± 100 ms; 5 of 4 intervals were out of tolerance, worst gap 2000 ms.

bugs.title: Firmware silent for 2000 ms during siren
bugs.description: The blocking delay(SIREN_MS) at line 38 halts all serial and pin activity for 2000 ms, exceeding the 700 ms limit. Measured 'no activity for 2000 ms' gaps across all scenarios confirm this. Firmware went silent for 2000 ms with no serial output or pin activity (limit 700 ms); 5 such gap(s).
bugs.evidence: Firmware went silent for 2000 ms with no serial output or pin activity (limit 700 ms); 5 such gap(s).
